criterion: An approved rollback rehearsal must succeed on the target release and production configuration.
explanation: The acceptance criterion requires all rollback rehearsals to succeed on R2.4/production. While RB-401 (KAN-108) passed, RB-402 (KAN-177) failed with data loss, and no evidence shows this defect was closed. Per the rules, an unclosed confirmed defect on the target build blocks the release.

evidence.excerpt: Rollback rehearsal RB-402: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment production. Restore completed but 214 session records written during the window were lost. Rehearsal FAILED.
evidence.why: QA Lead Arjun Mehta confirmed rollback rehearsal RB-402 failed with data loss in R2.4/production

evidence.excerpt: Rollback rehearsal RB-401: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment production. Previous version restored in 6 minutes; health probes pass; no data loss observed.
evidence.why: QA Lead Priya Nair confirmed rollback rehearsal RB-401 succeeded with no data loss
The requirement's acceptance criterion requires all rollback rehearsals to succeed; a failed rehearsal (RB-402) in the target build blocks the release
